title: CallLint artifact version
description: A precise, INSPECTABLE artifact belonging to one canonical subject (calllint.artifact-version.v1; §7.1, ADR 0061). This is the unit evidence attaches to, which is why `immutableDigest` is nullable and `artifactStatus` is an explicit enum rather than a boolean: an artifact that could not be resolved, could not be fetched, or is an unsupported package type is a real and distinct state that must survive into the record instead of being dropped. `UNAVAILABLE` and `UNSUPPORTED` never upgrade to a verdict of SAFE. Resolving an artifact NEVER executes it (INV-R3, the cardinal safety line): a remote-only artifact resolves to LOCAL_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED handling rather than being run to find out what it does. Written by R-4; the table and schema land in R-1 with the rest of the canonical DDL.
